## Finding

The program in the ticket stops sdcpp with "internal compiler error: in get_identifier, at
cc1_dummies.cc:132". This was reproduced for mcs51. The failure is in the preprocessor and does
not depend on the port.

## Cause

`c_common_has_attribute` in `support/cpp/gcc/c-family/c-lex.cc` calls `get_identifier` for the
attribute name. sdcpp contains no compiler proper, and `get_identifier` in
`support/cpp/gcc/cc1_dummies.cc` is a dummy that ends in an internal compiler error. Bug #3715
reports the same failure.

## Fix

The first patch for bug #3715 puts the call inside `#if 0`. The attribute lookup that would use
its result is inside `#if 0` in trunk. `__has_attribute` stays defined, checks its syntax, and
gives 0 for every name.

## Decision

`__has_attribute` gives 0 for every name, because the compiler has no `__attribute__` keyword. The
program in the ticket then takes its `#else` branch and defines `ALWAYS_INLINE` as empty. The
entry for bug #3715 describes the choices for the standard attributes and for `__has_builtin`.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-3715.c` starts with the conditional lines of this ticket and uses the
macro that they define on an inline function. Without the patch sdcc does not compile the test.
With it the test passes on the host, the six mcs51 variants, stm8, and ucz80.
